title: Редактирование выбросов
semantics: LAB-1103 PROPOSAL; not implemented or owner-approved. Detect keeps values; edit selects independent outlier/extreme policies keep/delete/mean/median/most_probable/constant/limit for continuous numeric fields. Always fit current input; three ports: edited rows, original outliers excluding extremes, original extremes. NULL is retained, excluded from fit. Observed IQR fixtures select upper-rank Q(p)=sorted_non_null[min(floor(n*p),n-1)] with strict fences. SD 1/2 mean uses normal values; median and histogram mode include all non-NULL training values; exact clipping and arbitrary-factor behavior still need preflight. Quality is hidden in 7.4.2 UI; frozen-model apply not established, source changes recompute even with Always Run. Neither mode is proposed.

fields.description: Complete continuous numeric field names; retain unlisted fields.

method.description: SD about mean or IQR fences.

ordered.description: Input already ordered; does not sort.

outlier_policy.description: Independent native policy for this class; new edit nodes require both. Side ports retain source values; delete removes rows only from port 0.

extreme_policy.description: Independent native policy for this class; new edit nodes require both. Side ports retain source values; delete removes rows only from port 0.
